record.paper_title: Erdős-Macintyre type theorem’s for multiple Dirichlet series: exceptional sets and open problems
record.original_question: For entire multiple Dirichlet series F∈D_p(λ^p), define M(x,F)=sup{|F(x+iy)|: y∈R^p}, m(x,F)=inf{|F(x+iy)|: y∈R^p}, and μ(x,F)=max{|a_n|exp(<x,λ_n>) : n∈Z_+^p}. Suppose the coordinate exponent sequences satisfy ∑_{k=0}∞ 1/(λ^{(j)}_{k+1}-λ^{(j)}_k)<∞ for every j=1,...,p. Is the estimate meas_p(E∩B_p(r))=O(r^(p−1)) as r→∞ the best possible description of exceptional sets E for which M(x,F)=(1+o(1))μ(x,F) and M(x,F)=(1+o(1))m(x,F) hold outside E as |x|→∞?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $p\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $\lambda^{(j)}=(\lambda^{(j)}_k)_{k\ge 0}$, for $j=1,\dots,p$, be strictly increasing sequences of nonnegative real numbers with $\lambda^{(j)}_k\to\infty$. Set $\lambda_n=(\lambda^{(1)}_{n_1},\dots,\lambda^{(p)}_{n_p})$ for $n=(n_1,\dots,n_p)\in\mathbb{Z}_+^p$, and let $D_p(\lambda^p)$ denote the class of entire functions on $\mathbb{C}^p$ representable by an absolutely convergent multiple Dirichlet series
$$F(s)=\sum_{n\in\mathbb{Z}_+^p} a_n\exp\langle s,\lambda_n\rangle,\qquad s\in\mathbb{C}^p,$$
where $\langle s,\lambda_n\rangle=\sum_{j=1}^p s_j\lambda^{(j)}_{n_j}$. For $x\in\mathbb{R}^p$ define
$$M(x,F)=\sup_{y\in\mathbb{R}^p}|F(x+iy)|,\quad m(x,F)=\inf_{y\in\mathbb{R}^p}|F(x+iy)|,\quad \mu(x,F)=\sup_{n\in\mathbb{Z}_+^p}|a_n|\exp\langle x,\lambda_n\rangle.$$
Let $B_p(r)=\{x\in\mathbb{R}^p:|x|\le r\}$ and let $\mathrm{meas}_p$ denote $p$-dimensional Lebesgue measure. Assume the spacing condition
$$\sum_{k=0}^{\infty}\frac{1}{\lambda^{(j)}_{k+1}-\lambda^{(j)}_k}<\infty\qquad(j=1,\dots,p).$$
Question: Is the bound $\mathrm{meas}_p(E\cap B_p(r))=O(r^{p-1})$ as $r\to\infty$ the best possible (sharp) description of the exceptional sets $E\subset\mathbb{R}^p$ outside which the asymptotic relations
$$M(x,F)=(1+o(1))\mu(x,F)\quad\text{and}\quad M(x,F)=(1+o(1))m(x,F)$$
hold as $|x|\to\infty$, for every $F\in D_p(\lambda^p)$? Equivalently: can the exponent $p-1$ be replaced by any smaller exponent, or are there examples showing it cannot be improved?
artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution was located. The problem is posed as a conjecture concerning sharpness of an exceptional-set bound for entire multiple Dirichlet series, and a targeted web search returned no evidence of a proof or counterexample, suggesting it remains open.

status_evidence.claim: The estimate is stated as an open conjecture about sharpness of the order r^(p-1).
